requirements.reason: Every current collection route must be deliberately bounded, parent-scoped, or removed from the live API instead of remaining an unresolved unbounded database read.
Pagination and offset pages must use stable ordering with tie-breakers so page boundaries remain deterministic.
Cursor routes must reject malformed cursors and cursors from a different query context without exposing raw database errors or widening scope.
List filters, user scope, admin scope, and parent-object binding must stay inside the database query before rows are returned.
Current query shapes must be reconciled with current model and migration indexes without speculative production workload assumptions.
List serialization must avoid obvious page-level N+1 database reads where current responses include related records.
Evidence must stay limited to repository-proven query, cursor, index, and serialization behavior and must not claim production query-plan or provider performance proof.
